text:
alex_m: Heads up — prepping Ashby private deploy for cert rotation + image sync tomorrow morning. Need owners for: egress rule confirmation, airgap image push, and HSM key provisioning. Anyone able to take one?

tara_ops: I can own egress rules. Can you post the required ports/IPs and the planned maintenance window? :white_check_mark:

samir: I can handle the image push into their offline registry. I need exact image tags + SHAs and any repo creds. @alex_m send artifact list when you have it.

jess: I can coordinate HSM onboarding with security, but we'll need legal to sign off on key material handling. @olivia_pe do we have DPA + key export approval status?

deploy-bot: Pipeline scheduled: `private-deploy/ashby` -> canary at 08:00 UTC (dry-run flag set).

alex_m: OK — quick artifact summary:
```
images:
  - redwood/runtime:2.4.1 sha=sha256:6a4f...9b2c
  - redwood/kv-cache:1.7.0 sha=sha256:bb1a...c33d
ports/IPs:
  - 443 TCP (ingress proxy)
  - 8443 TCP (internal api)
  - out: 13.32.0.0/16 (S3 egress), 52.95.0.0/16 (metrics)
maintenance-window: 08:00-09:30 UTC
```

mike_infra: Quick FYI — Ashby's firewall team asked if we support BGP peering. We only provided CIDRs earlier. If they require BGP, we'll need a NOC ticket and ASN. @tara_ops please confirm whether CIDR-only is acceptable.

tara_ops: I will confirm with their network lead. My preference is CIDR-only for speed; if they insist on BGP, tag me and I'll open NOC.

olivia_pe: DPA is in final legal review, expect sign-off EOD today. I'll ping legal now.

jess: Also small CR for airgap bootstrap: change cache path from `/tmp/redwood` to `/var/lib/redwood/cache` so it survives reboots. Samir, can you make that change and add a unit test?

samir: will submit PR #912 with the path change + test. ETA ~3h.

alex_m: Perfect. After PR merges I'll schedule a dry-run against their staging env. Also need an owner for smoke tests (post-deploy validation).

mike_infra: I can own smoke tests. Plan: 1) health endpoints (200/OK), 2) KV cache warm and verify hit rate, 3) baseline latency run (p95) — need test tokens and a small load generator.

alex_m: I'll create test tokens and put them in Vault at `secret/private/ashby/tests`.

tara_ops: tagging owners for clarity: @tara_ops (egress), @samir (image + bootstrap CR), @mike_infra (smoke tests), @jess (HSM + rollout), @olivia_pe (legal/DPA). If anyone else should be on the thread speak up.

jess: :thumbsup: I'll add the rollout window to the calendar invite and notify customer success for support coverage.

alex_m: Thanks all — if PR/DPAs land today we aim for the dry-run tomorrow 08:00 UTC. Will post runbook + rollback steps once smoke test checklist is final.
